description: a 5xx marks the provider unhealthy and the next provider serves the request

files.{HOME}/.optillm/proxy_config.yaml:
providers:
  - name: primary
    base_url: {MOCK}/v1
    api_key: sk-primary-key
  - name: secondary
    base_url: {MOCK}/v1
    api_key: sk-secondary-key
    model_map:
      gpt-4o-mini: mapped-model
routing:
  strategy: round_robin
  health_check:
    enabled: false
